conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need help. I’m at an ATM right now and I’ve had THREE different debit cards decline on me. My Green Account card, my Blue Account card, and my daughter’s teen account card. I really need cash — my car broke down and I need to pay the tow truck driver who only takes cash!

{"message":"I’m sorry that’s happening — I know this is stressful when you need cash right away. A few quick things we can try right now (no verification needed):

- Try a different ATM (preferably a Rho-Bank ATM). If a terminal is flagged, the same machine can decline multiple cards. 
- Check your mobile app for any card freeze/block or alert messages (sometimes cards are auto‑blocked or there’s a security hold).
- Try using a mobile wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) at a contactless terminal if you have it set up — that can bypass a damaged physical chip/stripe. 
- Ask the tow driver if they can accept card, Venmo/Cash App, or if a friend/family member can accept an EveryonePay (P2P) payment and withdraw cash. EveryonePay limit is $250/day. 

Useful limits to know (so you can see if you hit them):
- Green Account ATM daily limit: $600
- Blue Account ATM daily limit: $500
- Teen / Light Green Account ATM daily limit: $150

If you’d like me to look up your card/account status (to check for freezes, decline reasons, or request a temporary ATM limit increase), I can do that — but I’ll need to verify your identity first. I’ll need you to confirm any two of: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. Would you like to verify now so I can check and help immediately? If you prefer, I can also transfer you to a human agent."}
